scenes.audio: Ambient crowd noise and dramatic tennis highlights music with a building tempo.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A wide aerial shot of the Wimbledon tennis complex under a bright blue sky. The camera pans slowly. The environment is lush with green tennis courts and white stadium structures. The lighting is bright, natural daylight with a warm color grade.

scenes.audio: Crowd cheering loudly. Commentator: 'I repeat, 25th singles major.'
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A male tennis player, approximately 37 years old, with dark hair and a beard, wearing a white tennis kit, walks onto the court. He has a focused expression. The crowd in the background is cheering. The lighting is natural and bright.

scenes.audio: Rhythmic sound of the ball hitting the racket. Crowd gasps.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Wide shot of the tennis court during a rally. A player in white serves the ball. The camera is static from a high angle. The players move across the green grass court. Lighting is bright, even, and natural.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Close-up of the dark-haired player celebrating a point. He pumps his fist and nods. He is wearing a white Lacoste shirt. The background is a blurred crowd.

scenes.audio: Sound of ball impacts. Commentator: 'Asking for a check, we'll see.'
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Another rally between the two players. One player, younger with light brown hair and a white cap, hits a return. The camera tracks the ball's movement across the net.

scenes.audio: Music continues at a steady pace.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: A younger male player with light brown hair under a white cap looks down, appearing disappointed. He is wearing a white Asics kit.

scenes.audio: Fast-paced sound effects of shoes squeaking on grass and ball hits. Commentator: 'So far he has been... Oh wow, sensational!'
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: A series of quick cuts showing various points in the match. Players are sliding on the grass. The camera angle alternates between high-wide and low-angle tracking.

scenes.audio: Increased crowd volume. Commentator: 'Up on the bounce early there from the Australian.'
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The dark-haired player hits a powerful forehand. The camera follows the ball as it lands just inside the line. He walks toward the net. The crowd is shown in a wide shot, standing and clapping.

scenes.audio: Commentator: 'There it is! And first set for De Minaur. What a turn up for the books early on here on this center court.'
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: Match point sequence. The players engage in a long baseline rally. The dark-haired player wins the set. He walks to his bench. The crowd is highly animated.

scenes.audio: Intense breathing sounds and ball strikes. Commentator: 'But you expect him to lift and it’s happening in these first two points.'
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: A long, intense rally in the second set. Both players are covering the full width of the court. The dark-haired player executes a drop shot followed by a volley win. He celebrates toward the stands.

scenes.audio: Thudding sound of the ball bouncing on grass.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: Close-up of the dark-haired player's face, sweating and determined. He prepares for a serve, bouncing the ball several times.

scenes.audio: Commentator: 'Dangerous against a guy that can move like De Minaur.'
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Serve and volley sequence. The camera pans from the server to the receiver. The ball goes out of bounds.

scenes.audio: Loud roar from the player. Commentator: 'He’s got it! And second set, Djokovic levels up here on this center court.'
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The dark-haired player wins a critical point. He shouts toward his player box. A shot of the box shows men in white jackets with 'SILA' branding clapping.

scenes.audio: Fast-paced montage music. Commentator: 'Absolutely stunning from Djokovic... he's got the fourth set back on serve.'
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: A montage of highlights from the third and fourth sets. Intense net play and diving shots. The lighting remains bright and consistent.

scenes.audio: Commentator: 'Novak Djokovic is through to his 16th Wimbledon quarter-final!'
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The dark-haired player serves for the match. He hits an ace. He raises his arms in victory and walks toward the net.

scenes.audio: Sustained loud applause. Music swells to a finale.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: The two players shake hands at the net. They both walk toward the center of the court to wave at the crowd. The dark-haired player does his signature celebration, throwing his heart to the four corners of the stadium.
